description: A game whose primary comparison metric is LowerWins (e.g. completion time) resolves in favor of the smaller value.
notes: The Backend's Score.Value is hard-coded higher-wins (Score.cs: 'Higher is better; comparison policy lives on GameRound', and GameRound.WinnerId does a plain >). There is no lower-wins path at all. This is required for #11: the comparison engine must read MetricDirection per comparison key rather than assuming higher-wins.
